Awesome breakfast. Come here!
Aug 2020
Not a joint that I visit often even though it's a neighbouring restaurant, but I can tell you that the food and service here is so damn good.

From the bread basket, to the scrambled eggs, bacon and you would think that they grow the avocado themselves. Obviously, the coffee is also good, but only if you requested for "extra strong".

The photos below speak for themselves. Obviously, the menu items are fantastic, but because I don't eat eggs that have runny yolks, they are more than happy to comply to my requests for fantastic scrambled eggs as a substitute. 

The manager is ever present during opening hours so the waitresses are well-trained to be friendly and provide fantastic service.

Fine dining at mid-range prices.

COME....if only to try just once!

La Cochonaille event - cheese and wine buffet
Oct 2019
Ive only been here for their cheese and wine buffet that happens on the first Tuesday of every month.

The spread that you get for a buffet here in Saigon is outstanding. The popular luxury hotel that offers the same buffet does not compare. You wont find a better variety of quality cheeses for the price. The wine they provide is also great for free flow. 

Best money spent if you are a cheese and wine lover.
